rules: The host must pass the actual admitted renderer profile; OSMD 2.1.2 must never be represented as 2.1.1.
Renderer profile is presentation provenance only and grants no canonical mutation authority.
The admitted profile must be preserved across selection, edit, rerender request generation and history navigation.
Unreviewed renderer versions fail closed with INVALID_RENDERER_PROFILE.
Existing createEditorSession(score, notation, 'osmd') remains pinned to the legacy reviewed OSMD 2.1.1 profile.
This addendum creates no dependency from Editor Core to ST Score Rendering Layer.
